model_scope.name: Poolside Laguna S 2.1
model_scope.geometry: 32 local384 workgroups; four owners per KV head partition nine queries as 2+2+2+3

change.mechanism: Each of the twelve score-producing waves accumulates one maximum per owned query while it already owns the score, publishes 36 partial maxima before the existing phase barrier, and lets each output owner reduce twelve values instead of rescanning 512 scores.
change.removed_work: Four independent output-dimension waves no longer repeat the same 512-score maximum scan for each query.
unchanged: QK multiplication and wave32 reduction tree
change.synchronization: No new barrier; publication uses the existing score-to-softmax __syncthreads().

correctness.red: The focused wrapped/evicted oracle failed before implementation because the producer-max wrapper did not exist.
correctness.positions: 512-519 after ring wrap plus explicit position-200 eviction
